claims.text: Hepatic portal vein: brings nutrient-rich, oxygen-poor blood to the liver for filtering, about 75% of the liver's blood.
claims.quote: hepatic portal v.: carries blood for filtering -gives 75% of blood in liver (nutrient rich, O2 poor) to:

claims.text: Formation: the IMV and splenic vein join the SMV to form the portal vein; the SMV drains the right colon, the IMV the left.
claims.quote: SMV drain Rt LI, IMV drain Lt LI -IMV + splenic v. -> join SMV -> form HPV

claims.text: Stomach: drains through the right and left gastric veins into the portal or splenic vein.
claims.quote: stomach drained Rt/Lt gastric v. directly into portal or splenic v.

claims.text: Esophagus: a portal-systemic anastomosis, where varices form in portal hypertension.
claims.quote: Esophagus: site of portal-systemic anastomosis -> varices in portal HTN

claims.text: Esophageal varices are more likely with a portal-to-hepatic vein pressure gradient of 12 mmHg+.
claims.quote: ↑likelihood of portal HTN = visual esophageal varices -> P gradient b/n portal & hepatic veins + 12mmHg

claims.text: Portal hypertension: portal venous pressure above 5 mmHg.
Intrahepatic causes: cirrhosis, viral hepatitis, schistosomiasis, sarcoidosis; post-hepatic: hepatic vein thrombosis or right-heart disease that impairs pumping.
claims.quote: Intrahepatic portal HTN: vasc remodel w intrahepatic shunts, thrombosis, inflam or fibrosis Causes: cirrhosis, viral hepatitis, schistosomiasis (parasitic worm), sarcoidosis post-hepatic portal HTN: from hepatic v. thrombosis or ♡dx that impair pumping ability of Rt♡
